_comment: Hermes technical overlay for the canonical agent layer. Descriptions, working agreements, and closings come from content/agents.json and content/agents/*.md. Everything Hermes-specific (roles, sandboxes, model policy, runtime paragraph) lives here. To switch provider, use `hermes model`.
runtime_paragraph: You run as a Hermes agent with a fresh context for exactly one assignment. Sibling agent outputs are invisible to you. Your prompt carries the only handoff you may trust. Never ask the user a question.
